question: can you list the faculty who teach history at ramapo
answer:
The listed faculty teaching history include:
- David Colman, Associate Professor of African American History, School of Arts, Humanities, and Education. Courses include Age of Segregation, Black Power Years, and Introduction to African American History I and II. [3]
- Sam Ali Mustafa, Professor of History, School of Arts, Humanities, and Education. Courses include History Matters, History and Game Design, Politics of Europe, German History, and The Nazis. [4]
- Roark Atkinson, Associate Professor of History, School of Arts, Humanities, and Education. Courses include Introduction to U.S. History I, Colonial North America, and Era of the American Revolution. [5]
- Tae Kwak, Associate Professor of History, listed in the Honors Advisory Board. [13]
- John Gronbeck-Tedesco, Professor of American Studies, lists U.S. Cultural History among his teaching interests. [2]
The pages also list David Colman as an Associate Professor of African-American History. [16]
